sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:34

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:34:1
items.html: Within the letter Yod alone, which is Hochma, there is also the phase of Bina … the Yod itself is Hochma, and the two letters Vav, Dalet … are Bina itself: Its meaning is that the Yod of HaVaYaH is the phase of AB, and Hochma, which are the upper AVI of Atzilut, and the letter Yod itself is the phase of Aba, who is Hochma. And the filling of the Yod, which is Vav, Dalet, is the phase of the upper Ima, who is Bina. And the first Hey of HaVaYaH is the phase of SAG, who are YESHSUT of Atzilut, and the phase of the Yod that is in the corner of this Hey is the phase of Israel Saba, and the Hey itself is Tevuna, as he goes on to explain.
